title: Nicco Park | Kolkata Trips
description: Planning to visit Nicco Park Kolkata? Discover ticket prices, timings, rides, water park, history, attractions, visitor tips, nearby places, and FAQs.
textContent: Nicco Park If you’re looking for a fun-filled day in Kolkata, Nicco Park Kolkata is one destination that rarely disappoints. Spread across nearly 40 acres in Salt Lake City (Bidhannagar), the park combines exciting amusement rides, beautiful gardens, water attractions, restaurants, and educational exhibits, making it an ideal outing for visitors of all ages. Whether you’re travelling with children, planning a family picnic, enjoying a college excursion, or simply seeking a break from sightseeing, Nicco Park offers something for everyone. History of Nicco Park Kolkata Nicco Park opened its doors on 13 October 1991 with the vision of creating an international-standard amusement park in Eastern India. The park was developed by Nicco Parks & Resorts Limited, a joint venture involving the Nicco Group, the Government of West Bengal, and other institutional partners. It was designed with technical assistance from renowned international consultants to ensure world-class safety standards and ride quality. Over the years, the park has continuously expanded with new attractions, earning certifications for safety and environmental management. Today, it is regarded as one of India’s best-maintained amusement parks. Architecture and Park Design Unlike many traditional amusement parks, Nicco Park was designed as an environmentally friendly recreational space. Some notable features include: Beautiful landscaped gardens Artificial lakes Tree-lined walkways Water bodies that naturally cool the surroundings Eco-friendly infrastructure Large open spaces ideal for families The combination of greenery and amusement rides creates a pleasant atmosphere, especially during winter. Top Rides at Nicco Park One of the biggest reasons visitors come to Nicco Park Kolkata is its wide variety of rides suitable for every age group. Thrill Rides Adventure lovers can enjoy: Cyclone Roller Coaster Sky Diver Flying Saucer Moon Raker Pirate Ship Twist and Turn Giant Cyclone These rides offer adrenaline-pumping excitement while maintaining strict safety standards. Family Rides Families with children can enjoy: Toy Train River Cave Ride Paddle Boats Cable Car Merry-Go-Round Water Chute Family Carousel These attractions are suitable for visitors of different age groups. Children’s Rides Young visitors especially enjoy: Mini Cars Kiddies Ride Swing Chair Jumping Frog Mini Train Children’s Carousel Nicco Super Bowl (Bowling Alley) The park also houses Nicco Super Bowl, one of Kolkata’s most popular bowling centres. Visitors can enjoy: Bowling lanes Arcade games Indoor entertainment Food court It is particularly popular among teenagers and corporate groups. Wet-O-Wild Water Park Located inside the Nicco Park complex, Wet-O-Wild is one of the largest water parks in Eastern India. Popular attractions include: Wave Pool Water Slides Lazy River Family Pool Rain Dance Kids Pool The water park is especially crowded during the summer months. Educational Attractions Nicco Park is more than just an amusement park. Educational exhibits include: Solar Energy Village Rose Garden Aviary Green initiatives Environmental awareness exhibits Schools often organise educational visits here. Timings Nicco Park generally operates: Amusement Park 10:30 AM – 6:30 PM Wet-O-Wild Usually opens around 10:30 AM Closing time varies seasonally Operating hours may change during festivals, maintenance, or special events. Entry Fee & Ticket Prices Ticket prices vary depending on: Park-only access Park + Unlimited Rides Wet-O-Wild access Combo Packages Since prices are revised periodically, visitors are advised to check the official website before planning their visit. Best Time to Visit Nicco Park The ideal months are: October November December January February Winter offers pleasant weather, shorter waiting times, and comfortable outdoor activities. Summer is perfect for visitors interested in the water park. Weekdays are usually less crowded than weekends. How to Reach Nicco Park By Metro The nearest metro station is on Kolkata’s East-West Metro corridor, with easy onward transport by auto or taxi. By Bus Numerous government and private buses connect Salt Lake with: Esplanade Howrah Sealdah Garia Airport By Taxi App-based taxis and local cabs are readily available throughout Kolkata. By Air From Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Nicco Park is approximately 12–15 km away and can typically be reached in 30–45 minutes, depending on traffic. Nearby Attractions Visitors often combine Nicco Park with other attractions in Salt Lake and New Town. Popular nearby places include: Eco Park Mother’s Wax Museum Biswa Bangla Gate Science City Aquatica New Town Coffee House Nalban Boating Complex Facilities Available Visitors can enjoy: Multiple restaurants Snack counters Drinking water First aid Restrooms Parking Locker facilities Souvenir shops Wheelchair accessibility (selected areas) Visitor Tips Arrive early to enjoy more rides. Wear comfortable clothing and walking shoes. Carry sunscreen during summer. Keep a change of clothes if visiting Wet-O-Wild. Follow all ride safety instructions. Height and age restrictions apply for several rides. Weekdays offer shorter queues. Keep valuables secure while enjoying water attractions. Why Visit Nicco Park? Nicco Park continues to be one of the best recreational destinations in Kolkata because it combines: Exciting thrill rides Family-friendly attractions Beautiful landscaped gardens Water park adventures Bowling and indoor games Educational exhibits Excellent maintenance and safety standards Whether you are visiting Kolkata for the first time or are a local resident looking for a refreshing weekend outing, Nicco Park promises an enjoyable experience for every member of the family. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1. Where is Nicco Park located? Nicco Park is located in Salt Lake City (Bidhannagar), Kolkata, West Bengal. 2. What are the Nicco Park timings? The park generally remains open from 10:30 AM to 6:30 PM. 3. What is the ticket price for Nicco Park? Ticket prices vary depending on ride packages and water park access. Check the official website for the latest rates. 4. Is Wet-O-Wild included in the regular ticket? No. Wet-O-Wild usually requires a separate ticket or combo package. 5. Which is the most popular ride? The Cyclone Roller Coaster is among the park’s most popular thrill rides. 6. Is Nicco Park suitable for children? Yes. The park offers numerous rides and attractions designed specifically for children. 7. How much time is required to explore Nicco Park? A full day is recommended to enjoy both the amusement park and the water park. 8. Is outside food allowed? Outside food is generally not permitted inside the park. 9. Is parking available? Yes. Paid parking is available for visitors. 10. Is Nicco Park safe? Yes. The park follows international safety standards and maintains its rides regularly. 11. What is the best season to visit? Winter (October to February) is considered the most comfortable season for visiting. 12. Can senior citizens visit Nicco Park? Yes. The park has landscaped gardens, restaurants, and family-friendly attractions suitable for all age groups. 13. Is photography allowed? Yes. Personal photography is generally permitted throughout most areas of the park. 14. Can tickets be booked online? Yes. Online booking is available through the park’s official website. 15. Which attractions are near Nicco Park? Nearby attractions include Eco Park, Mother’s Wax Museum, Biswa Bangla Gate, Science City, Nalban Boating Complex, and Aquatica.
